title: Electronic systematic recording of pulmonary aspiration events during hospital care
summary: Penetration of foreign material below the vocal fold level into the trachea and deeper sections of the lung is a feared complication, occurs only occasionally, and can be fatal in pulmonary failure. The course of the disease is variable and difficult to predict. Therefore, concomitant circumstances, treatment data of patients with such a complication will be systematically collected and evaluated in an electronic database.  From this, influencing factors (e.g. type of foreign material, concomitant drugs) that affect the course of the disease will be determined in order to gain new treatment options.

interventions.name: All hospitalized patients with a pulmonary aspiration that has taken place

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients treated in the hospital who had a single or repeated pulmonary aspiration immediately before or during their stay.
Exclusion criteria:
No aspiration has occurred. Patients in whom the aspiration event occurred more than 12 hours prior to hospital admission. Aspiration in an external hospital with subsequent transfer.
